nodes.label: catDeportes.jpg — Sports Categories Hero Image
nodes.description: Flat-lay photograph of multiple sports equipment items arranged in a circle on green grass. Items visible: soccer ball, basketball, volleyball, rugby/American football, tennis racket, badminton racket, table-tennis (ping-pong) paddles, baseball glove, baseball bat, tennis balls, shuttlecock, jump rope, athletic sneakers, and a red water bottle. The composition creates a visually rich, colourful collage representing the variety of sports offered by the DeporteParaTodos platform. Used as a generic sports-category banner or placeholder image throughout the Angular application (e.g. HomeComponent category cards and CursosDeportivosComponent).
nodes.design_purpose: Hero/banner image for the sports-categories section of the DeporteParaTodos frontend. Communicates multi-sport scope at a glance without text.
